R1: With your team ahead, give ground after the first contact instead of extending the hold, preserving the advantage while conceding some space.
R2: As the last defender, look for an isolated fight from cover rather than committing to a long hold, giving up space for a chance to split the attackers.
R3: With both teams intact, hold where you can fall back after contact, giving up an early fight to keep a defender available.
R5: After the opening fights, reset to cover while your team is ahead, sacrificing another immediate peek to protect the advantage you built.
R6: On an early defence hold, choose a position you can leave after contact, conceding some ground to avoid being removed before your team can respond.
R7: After your opening kill, slow the next peek and fall back toward your team, giving up pressure to preserve the numbers advantage.
R8: Once you have the first kill, take one more shot at most before returning to cover, trading a chance at another kill for a safer hold.
R13: With your team already down in numbers, enter on a teammate's flash or drone, risking a slower take for a better chance of winning the next fight.
R14: With your team down one, name the teammate following before you lead the next push, gaining a chance to answer your death at the cost of a slower entry.
R16: Before the next fast entry, call which teammate follows you, keeping the speed of the push while risking less separation from the group.
FOCUS: Before an aggressive peek or entry, name the teammate close enough to kill your killer so your next review can check whether the fight had an immediate answer.
